newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's NSW says no decision on TAB sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's NSW says no decision on TAB sale.

text.p: The New South Wales (NSW) state government said on Wednesday it had made no decision on whether to sell its Totalisator Agency Board (TAB) betting agency.

"There has been no decision to sell TAB," Michael Coutts-Trotter, a spokesman for the NSW treasury department, told Reuters. Newspapers have reported that the NSW government could raise about A$1 billion from the public float of TAB.
A sale of the NSW TAB would follow the sale by the Victorian government of its betting agency through a share float in 1994.
The Victorian government raised A$810 million from the sale.
The TAB businesses were sold to Tabcorp Holdings Ltd, whose shares have more than doubled from their A$2.70 issue price in August 1994.
Tabcorp shares closed three cents up at A$5.68 on Wednesday.
